verdict.rationale: Apify can be driven entirely without a UI. An official CLI is documented for use "from terminal or shell scripts" (apify-docs-3, apify-probe-4). JS and Python API clients can start Actors, wait for completion and fetch results programmatically (apify-docs-15, apify-docs-16, apify-docs-23), backed by retries, typed errors and log streaming (apify-docs-27, apify-docs-18, apify-docs-19). Schedules, webhooks and a published OpenAPI spec (apify-docs-6, apify-docs-14, apify-probe-2) round out unattended automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions or non-interactive token auth for the CLI), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
